claims.claim_text: I observed the subject seated in the front passenger seat with his head slumped forward against the dashboard.
I observed two additional occupants: a female in the driver's seat (W-1) and a male in the left rear seat (W-2).
I approached the passenger side of the vehicle and made contact with the subject.
I instructed the subject to step out of the vehicle and place his hands where I could see them.
I observed that the subject's right hand was bandaged.
The subject became increasingly agitated and stated, "You're not taking me in, I'll kill you before that happens."
Officer Sandoval located drug paraphernalia on W-2's person and placed W-2 in handcuffs.
Without warning, the subject reached across to the driver's side, started the vehicle, and slowly began to roll the vehicle backward.
I observed W-2 move clear of the vehicle's path.
I discharged my firearm three times toward the vehicle. Officer Sandoval simultaneously discharged his firearm twice through the front windshield.
A search of the subject's person revealed a loaded Hellcat .380 semi-automatic handgun in the right pocket of his jacket.
At approximately 1015 hours, Officer Sandoval and I were assigned to the Community Policing Unit and were patrolling in a marked police vehicle.
The vehicle came to a stop after traveling approximately 15 feet forward.
Officer Sandoval and I removed the subject from the vehicle and immediately began administering CPR.
